program_name: Challenging the Frontiers of Poverty Reduction (CFPR)
intervention_description: Grant-based approach combining asset transfer, subsistence allowance, livelihood support services, health support, and social awareness training for extreme poor women

graduation_components_rationale.consumption_support: Subsistence allowance mentioned in intervention description
graduation_components_rationale.healthcare: Regular health services provided, especially for pregnant women
graduation_components_rationale.assets: Productive asset base given to participant households
graduation_components_rationale.skills_training: Livelihood support services and training mentioned
graduation_components_rationale.coaching: Programme organizers make regular household visits
graduation_components_rationale.social_empowerment: Social Development programme designed to empower poor by increasing social awareness

outcomes.outcome_description: Value of houses in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT)
outcomes.literal_text: On average, the value of the houses went up by BDT 1197 (US $ 17.16) due to programme participation and this increase was found to be statistically significant at the 5% level
outcomes.text_position: Results section, paragraph on housing status

outcomes.outcome_description: Cash savings in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT) per participant woman
outcomes.literal_text: Effect on savings was BDT 1564 (US $22.42) per participant woman on average

outcomes.outcome_description: Percentage increase in sanitary latrine holdings
outcomes.literal_text: Sanitary latrine holdings increased by 36% among the participant households
Difference-in-difference of awareness index positive and statistically significant at 1% level
Difference-in-difference statistically insignificant for outstanding loans
outcomes.text_position: Results section, paragraph on credit market

outcomes.outcome_description: Total food expenditure in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT)
outcomes.literal_text: Total food expenditure on average BDT 16.70 more for treatment households, significant at 5% level
outcomes.text_position: Results section, paragraph on food security
